notes: Screen 5 answer key: the source .doc's highlighting could not be read, so the 2 orders to implement first were taken from the rationale (humidified oxygen and the 12-lead ECG). Please confirm.

Oxygen is keyed as anticipated (screen 4) and as a first priority (screen 5) although SpO2 is 97% on room air; oxygen is not routinely indicated at that saturation. Consider lowering the SpO2 or re-keying.

Treatment gaps: a beta-blocker (propranolol) is a cornerstone of thyroid storm treatment for the tachycardia and is not in the orders or options; propylthiouracil is often preferred to methimazole in thyroid storm (blocks T4-to-T3 conversion), and iodine and glucocorticoids are also usual. Consider adding propranolol to the orders/options.
Screen 5 rationale said "Now medication orders should be implemented within 60-90 minutes"; removed (a STAT/now order is given promptly). The order "Admission" was written as "Admit to the hospital".
